verdict.rationale: The models page documents versioned IDs (`jev-latest`/`jev-preview` resolving to a pinned version like `jev-1.13.0`) and advises pinning a specific version if you've tuned thresholds, giving some self-service migration control, but there is no explicit deprecation/retirement policy, no advance-notice timeline, and no dedicated migration guide for when an older model is actually sunset. Missing for 10: an explicit deprecation schedule/notice period, documented end-of-life dates for older versions, and a migration guide for moving between versions.
